data.one_liner: Encode and decode Open Location Codes (Plus Codes) for latitude/longitude.
data.what_it_does: Provides functions to convert a latitude/longitude pair into a Plus Code and back. It also supports shortening and expanding codes relative to a reference location, all offline.
use_when: You need a street‑address‑like code for places without traditional addresses
You want an offline, no‑service location encoding
You need to generate or parse Plus Codes in a Dart/Flutter app
avoid_when: You require geocoding of place names to coordinates
You need dynamic reference locations that change frequently
strengths: Simple API, no build_runner or codegen
weaknesses: No built‑in geocoding, so reference locations must be supplied manually
Limited to Plus Code format only
data.minimal_example:
```dart
import 'package:open_location_code/open_location_code.dart';

final code = OpenLocationCode.encode(6.1, 36.2); // e.g., "6GCRPR6C+24"
final location = OpenLocationCode.decode(code);
print(location.latitude); // 6.1
print(location.longitude); // 36.2
```
